screenshots.shows: The title screen over a freshly dealt table: the four sigils, the rules in brief, and the Begin the duel button.

A live first round in progress: both rows on the table, a Spy defected into each row, a bonded Thorn Pack doubled to 8, row totals 21 to 17 in the score strip, and the player's six-card hand with a Hex ready.
The victory screen after a directed duel the player won two crowns to none, with the round-by-round totals and a Play again button.
The defeat screen after a directed duel the Warden won two crowns to none, with the round-by-round totals and a Play again button.
